sources.role: Windows standalone implementation, DirectInput mapping, INI configuration, BIOS and save-state code
official upstream README and HTML help

paths.naming: WinAPI private-profile INI sections [Console], [Display], [Sound], [Emulation], [Input], [Recent]; controller entries are Input Key0..Key11 and Device0..Device11
evidence: source:Win/Main.cpp derives common_defaultPath from executable path @3040295934c68024ecf89b45b50107ea1c271e66

paths.naming: Key0..Key11/Device0..Device11 map controller 1 and 2 right,left,down,up,button1,button2; Key12..Key16/Device12..Device16 map reset,select,pause,right-difficulty,left-difficulty. Device 0 is Keyboard; nonzero values are DirectInput enumeration values. Key values are DirectInput scan codes or Win/Input.h e_joy_value values.
evidence: source:Win/Input.cpp input_keys/input_devices defaults and dialog ordering

paths.path: No universal emulator-managed save directory; cartridge data is loaded from explicit .a78/raw/ZIP media
evidence: source:Help/File.htm supported cartridge formats and open dialog @3040295934c68024ecf89b45b50107ea1c271e66

paths.path: User-selected destination from Ctrl+S/File Save; [Console] Save.Path stores the last dialog path
paths.naming: Uncompressed user-selected .sav or ZIP containing Save.sav; load requires the embedded cartridge digest to match
evidence: source:Core/ProSystem.cpp prosystem_Save/prosystem_Load and archive member Save.sav

paths.path: Optional caller-selected BIOS path in [Emulation] Bios.Filename; raw files and archives are accepted
paths.naming: No canonical BIOS filename or checksum is published; BIOS is not required to run

paths.path: No separate key file; keyboard and DirectInput values are stored in [Input] of ProSystem.ini
paths.naming: KeyN/DeviceN byte values; user menu values remain User_KeyN/User_DeviceN/User_ModifierN

linux.reason: The official source is Windows API/DirectX only; no native Linux runtime contract is established.

linux-flatpak.reason: No Linux runtime or official Flatpak package is established by the upstream source.

macos.reason: The official source is Windows API/DirectX only; no native macOS runtime contract is established.
